<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

        var endX = 0;
        var threshold = 50; // minimum swipe distance

        var carouselElement = document.getElementById('myCarousel1');

            startX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
        }, { passive: true });

        carouselElement.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
            endX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;

            var diff = startX - endX;

                    $carousel.carousel('next'); // swipe left

            }
        }, { passive: true });

    }, 1000);
});

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

        var endX = 0;
        var threshold = 50; // minimum swipe distance

        var carouselElement = document.getElementById('myCarousel1');

            startX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
        }, { passive: true });

        carouselElement.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
            endX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;

            var diff = startX - endX;

                    $carousel.carousel('next'); // swipe left

            }
        }, { passive: true });

    }, 1000);

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

function hoverdiv(e, divid, movement, content) {
    const rect = e.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = rect.left + rect.width + window.scrollX;
    const y = rect.top + window.scrollY;
    var div = document.getElementById(divid);
    div.style.left = x;
    div.style.top = y;
    if (movement == "over" && content.length > 55)
        div.style.visibility = "visible";
    else div.style.visibility = "hidden";
}

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    function scrollToSection(hash) {
        let targetElement = document.getElementById(hash.split('_tab')[0].split('#')[0])?.querySelector('.nav-link');
        console.log("Attempting to scroll to:", hash, targetElement);

        if (targetElement) {
            targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            setTimeout(()=> {
                document.querySelector('.we-multi-content-tab ').scrollIntoView({ behavior: "instant", block: "start"  });
            },100)
        } else {
            console.log("Element not found, waiting for it...");
            let observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
                let retryElement = document.getElementById(hash);
                if (retryElement) {
                    observer.disconnect();
                    retryElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            });

            observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        }
    }

    if (window.location.hash) {
        console.log("window.location.hash ->", window.location.hash);
        scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
    }

    Liferay.on('endNavigate', function () {
        if (window.location.hash) {
				
        console.log("window.location.hash - endNavigate ->", window.location.hash);
            scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
        }
    });
});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    document.getElementById('navigationToggelContent').style.visibility = 'visible';

    let currentPath = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/(en|ar)\//, "/");; // Extracts only the path

    const links = document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-item');
    const togglerButton = document.querySelector('.toggler-button');
    let rtlActive = document.dir === 'rtl';

    let activeFound = false;

    links.forEach(link => {
        const anchor = link.querySelector('a');
        if (anchor && anchor.getAttribute('href')) {
            // Extract path from anchor href
            let anchorPath = new URL(anchor.href, window.location.origin).pathname;

            console.log("Anchor Path:", anchorPath, "Current Path:", currentPath);

            //if (currentPath === anchorPath) {
            if (currentPath.includes(anchorPath)) {
                link.classList.add('active');
                activeFound = true;
            } else {
                link.classList.remove('active');
            }
        } else {
            link.classList.remove('active');
        }
    });

    // If no active link is found, remove active class from toggler button
    if (!activeFound) {
        togglerButton.classList.remove('active');
    } else {
        if (links.length > 1 && links[1].classList.contains('active')) {
            togglerButton.classList.add('active');
        } else {
            togglerButton.classList.remove('active');
        }
    }

    // Toggle function
    togglerButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (rtlActive) currentPath = currentPath.replace('/ar', '');

        if (links.length > 1 && links[1].querySelector('a') && currentPath === new URL(links[1].querySelector('a').href, window.location.origin).pathname) {
            window.location.href = links[0].querySelector('a').href;
        } else if (links.length > 1 && links[0].querySelector('a')) {
            window.location.href = links[1].querySelector('a').href;
        }
    });

    function scrollToSection(hash) {

            setTimeout(() => {

            }, 300);
        }
    }

    if (window.location.hash) {
        scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
    }

    // Handle Liferay SPA navigation interference
    Liferay.on('endNavigate', function () {
        if (window.location.hash) {
            scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));

    });

	function getValueByAttribute(node, attr) {
		return (
			node.dataset[attr] ||
			(node.parentElement && node.parentElement.dataset[attr])
		);
	}

	function sendDocumentDownloadedAnalyticsEvent(anchor) {
		var fileEntryId = getValueByAttribute(
			anchor,
			'analyticsFileEntryId'
		);
		var title = getValueByAttribute(
			anchor,
			'analyticsFileEntryTitle'
		);
		var version = getValueByAttribute(
			anchor,
			'analyticsFileEntryVersion'
		);

		if (fileEntryId) {
			Analytics.send('documentDownloaded', 'Document', {
				groupId: themeDisplay.getScopeGroupId(),
				fileEntryId,
				preview: !!window._com_liferay_document_library_analytics_isViewFileEntry,
				title,
				version,
			});
		}
	}

	function handleDownloadClick(event) {
		if (window.Analytics) {
			if (event.target.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
				sendDocumentDownloadedAnalyticsEvent(
					event.target
				);
			}
			else if (
				event.target.parentNode &&
				event.target.parentNode.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a'
			) {
				sendDocumentDownloadedAnalyticsEvent(
					event.target.parentNode
				);
			}
			else {
				var target = event.target;
				var matchTextContent =
					target.textContent &&
					target.textContent.toLowerCase() ===
						'تنزيل';
				var matchTitle =

				var matchAction = target.action === 'download';
				var matchLexiconIcon = !!target.querySelector(
					'.lexicon-icon-download'
				);
				var matchLexiconClassName = target.classList.contains(
					'lexicon-icon-download'
				);
				var matchParentTitle =
					target.parentNode &&
					target.parentNode.title &&
					target.parentNode.title.toLowerCase() === 'download';
				var matchParentLexiconClassName =
					target.parentNode &&
					target.parentNode.classList.contains('lexicon-icon-download');

				if (
					matchTextContent ||
					matchTitle ||
					matchParentTitle ||
					matchAction ||
					matchLexiconIcon ||
					matchLexiconClassName ||
					matchParentLexiconClassName
				) {

					);

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}

    function toggleExpand(event, element) {
        if (event.target.closest('a')) {
            return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var fotterItems = document.querySelectorAll('.footer_container .expandable_item');
        fotterItems.forEach(function (item) { 
            var child = item.children[0];
            if (item.id == ("footer_" + element)) {
                if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-show');
                    child.classList.add('we-hide');
                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                } else {
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                }
            } else if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                child.classList.remove('we-show');
                child.classList.add('we-hide');
            }
        });
    }

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

			<script>
 document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const modalEl = document.querySelector('.home_internet_calc');
  if (!modalEl) return;   // CHANGED: حماية لو العنصر مش موجود
  modalEl.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
	setTimeout(()=> {  
	 if(!document.querySelector('.modal.fade.show.home_internet_calc'))
     { 
		 calculateHomeInternetAgain();
     }
	},10)
  });
 });

var lang_ar = document.dir=="rtl";

/* ===================== NEW: جدول مصاريف تغيير الباقة (من الصورة) =====================
   المفتاح  = سعة الإنترنت الأرضي الحالية (الباقة الافتراضية للـ Gold) بالجيجا
   القيمة   = { السعة المطلوبة : المصاريف جنيه/شهر }
   اللي مش موجود في الجدول مش بيظهر في قايمة "الإنترنت الأرضى المطلوب" */
var FEES_TABLE = {
  150: { 200: 75,  250: 145, 400: 330,  750: 650 },   // Gold 300 / Gold 600
  250: { 400: 185, 750: 505 },                         // Gold 890 / Gold 1200
  400: { 750: 320, 1500: 1070 },                       // Gold 1500
  750: { 1500: 750 }                                   // Gold 2300
};

/* ===================== NEW: دوال مساعدة ===================== */
function hiDigits(s) {   // أرقام عربية -> إنجليزية
  return String(s == null ? '' : s)
    .replace(/[\u0660-\u0669]/g, function (d) { return d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x0660; })
    .replace(/[\u06F0-\u06F9]/g, function (d) { return d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x06F0; });
}
function hiNorm(s) {     // مقارنة الأسماء بدون مسافات أو حروف كبيرة
  return hiDigits(s).replace(/\s+/g, '').toLowerCase();
}
function hiQuota(name, fallback) {   // "Super 150 GB" -> 150
  var m = hiDigits(name).match(/\d+/);
  if (m) return parseInt(m[0], 10);
  var n = parseFloat(hiDigits(fallback));
  return isNaN(n) ? NaN : n;
}
function hiReadBundles(selectEl) {   // يقرأ كل الباقات من قايمة desiredPackage
  var opts = Array.from(selectEl.options);
  var list = [];
  for (var i = 1; i < opts.length; i++) {
    var value = opts[i].value;
    var parts = value.split(',');
    var bundle = parts[2].split(':')[1];
    var bundleValue = parts[3].split(':')[1];
    list.push({
      value: value,
      price: parts[0].split(':')[1],
      bundleName: bundle,
      bundleValue: bundleValue,
      quota: hiQuota(bundle, bundleValue)
    });
  }
  return list;
}
function hiFindBundle(list, name) {  // يدور بالاسم، ولو مفيش تطابق بالرقم
  var key = hiNorm(name);
  var found = list.find(function (b) { return hiNorm(b.bundleName) == key; });
  if (found) return found;
  var q = hiQuota(name);
  if (isNaN(q)) return null;
  return list.find(function (b) { return b.quota == q; }) || null;
}
function hiOptionsHtml(list, currentBundle) {   // يبني options (الظاهر والمخفي)
  var html = [];
  html.push('<option selected disabled  value>' + (document.dir == "ltr" ? 'Select Bundle' : 'اختر') + '</option>');
  list.forEach(function (b) {
    var show = false;
    if (currentBundle) {
      var row = FEES_TABLE[currentBundle.quota];
      if (row) show = row.hasOwnProperty(b.quota);            // حسب الجدول
      else show = +b.price > +currentBundle.price;            // احتياطي: حسب السعر
    }
    html.push("<option " + (show ? "" : "style='display:none' ") + " value='" + b.value + "'>" + b.bundleName + "</option>");
  });
  return html;
}

/* ===================== CHANGED: الحساب ===================== */
function calculateHomeInternet() {  
  // --- NEW: نحسب الأول، ولو في مشكلة نوقف من غير ما نبوظ الشاشة ---
  var currentPackageValue = document.querySelector(".modal.show #currentPackage").value;
  var defaultBundleName = currentPackageValue.split(',')[1].split(':')[1];
  var desiredValue = document.querySelector(".modal.show #desiredPackage").value;
  var desiredBundleName = desiredValue.split(',')[2].split(':')[1];
  var bundles = hiReadBundles(document.querySelector(".modal.show #desiredPackage"));

  var currentPackage = hiFindBundle(bundles, defaultBundleName);
  if (!currentPackage) {
    var cq = hiQuota(defaultBundleName);
    if (!isNaN(cq)) currentPackage = { price: NaN, bundleName: defaultBundleName, quota: cq };
  }
  var desiredPackage = hiFindBundle(bundles, desiredBundleName);
  if (!currentPackage || !desiredPackage) {
    console.error('[calc] bundle not found', defaultBundleName, desiredBundleName, bundles);
    return;
  }

  var result;
  var row = FEES_TABLE[currentPackage.quota];
  if (row && row.hasOwnProperty(desiredPackage.quota)) {
    result = row[desiredPackage.quota];                          // من جدول المصاريف
  } else {
    result = desiredPackage.price - currentPackage.price;        // احتياطي: فرق السعر (من غير المعاملات القديمة)
  }
  var desiredPackageExtraFeesValue = desiredValue.split(',')[1].split(':')[1];
  result += +desiredPackageExtraFeesValue;
  if (isNaN(result)) { console.error('[calc] fee is NaN', currentPackage, desiredPackage); return; }
  result = result.toFixed(2);

  // --- الجزء ده زي الأصلي ---
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #home-internet-after-calculate').style.display = "block";
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #home-internet-before-calculate').style.display = "none";
 
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #current_package_after_calculate').innerText = currentPackageValue.split(',')[0].split(':')[1];
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #current_fixed_internet_after_calculate').innerText = document.querySelector('.modal.show #currentFixedInternet').value;
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #desired_fixed_internet_after_calculate').innerText = desiredBundleName;

  if (lang_ar == false) {
    document.querySelector('.modal.show #upgrade_fees').innerHTML = result + " EGP/ Month";
  } else {
    document.querySelector('.modal.show #upgrade_fees').innerHTML = result + " جنية مصري/ شهر";
  }

  document.querySelector('.modal.show #desiredPackage').disabled = true;
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #currentPackage').disabled = true;
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #submit-home-caluclator-button').disabled = true;
  if(screen.width < 768) 
  { document.querySelector('.modal.show #calculator-inputs-section').style.display = "none";
    document.querySelector('.modal.show #calc_installments_again_mobile').style.display = "block";
    document.querySelector('.modal.show #result_section_title').style.display = "block";
    document.querySelector('.modal.show #calculator_title').style.display = "none";
  }
}

function calculateHomeInternetAgain() {  
  document.querySelector('.modal #home-internet-after-calculate').style.display = "none";
  document.querySelector('.modal #home-internet-before-calculate').style.display = "flex";
  document.querySelector('.modal #extra_fees_row').style.display='none';
  document.querySelector('.modal #submit-home-caluclator-button').disabled = true;
  document.querySelector('.modal #desiredPackage').disabled = false;
  document.querySelector('.modal #currentPackage').disabled = false;
	
  if(screen.width < 1200) 
  { document.querySelector('.modal #calculator-inputs-section').style.display = "block";
    document.querySelector('.modal #calc_installments_again_mobile').style.display = "none";
  }
  if(screen.width < 768) 
  {         
    document.querySelector('#result_section_title').style.display = "none";
    document.querySelector('#calculator_title').style.display = "block";
  }

  // CHANGED: كان بيمسح كل inputs و selects في الصفحة كلها، دلوقتي بس بتوع الحاسبة
  document.querySelectorAll('.home_internet_calc input').forEach(e=>e.value ='');
  document.querySelectorAll('.home_internet_calc select').forEach(e=>e.value ='');

  // CHANGED: رجّع قايمة الباقات المطلوبة فاضية (حتى لو المودال اتقفل)
  var desiredSelect = document.querySelector(".modal.show #desiredPackage") ||
                      document.querySelector("#body_775123 #desiredPackage");
  if (desiredSelect) {
    desiredSelect.innerHTML = hiOptionsHtml(hiReadBundles(desiredSelect), null).join('');
  }
}

/* ===================== زي الأصلي من غير تغيير ===================== */
function selectDesiredBundle() {  
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #extra_fees_row').style.display='none';
  var desiredPackageExtraFeesValue = document.querySelector(".modal.show #desiredPackage").value?.split(',')[1].split(':')[1];
  var desiredPackageExtraFeesName = document.querySelector(".modal.show #desiredPackage").value?.split(',')[4].split(':')[1];
  console.log(desiredPackageExtraFeesValue,desiredPackageExtraFeesName)
  if(!+desiredPackageExtraFeesValue&&!desiredPackageExtraFeesName)
    document.querySelector('.modal.show #extra_fees_row').style.display='none';
  else document.querySelector('.modal.show #extra_fees_row').style.display = 'block';
  document.querySelector(".modal.show #home-internet-extraFeesNameInput").innerHTML = desiredPackageExtraFeesName;

  if (lang_ar == false) {
    document.querySelector(".modal.show #home-internet-extraFeesValueInput").value = desiredPackageExtraFeesValue;
  } else {
    document.querySelector(".modal.show #home-internet-extraFeesValueInput").value = desiredPackageExtraFeesValue ;
  }
  if(document.querySelector(".modal.show #desiredPackage").value != '' && document.querySelector('.modal.show #currentPackage').value != '' )   
    document.querySelector('.modal.show #submit-home-caluclator-button').disabled = false;
  else document.querySelector('.modal.show #submit-home-caluclator-button').disabled = true;
}

/* ===================== CHANGED: اختيار الباقة الحالية ===================== */
function selectCurrentFunction() {
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #extra_fees_row').style.display='none';
  var currentPackage = document.querySelector(".modal.show #currentPackage").value;
  var defaultBundleName = currentPackage.split(',')[1].split(':')[1];

  // نقرأ كل الباقات من الـ select زي الأصلي
  var desiredSelectSource = document.querySelector("#body_775123 #desiredPackage");
  var list = hiReadBundles(desiredSelectSource);

  // NEW: مطابقة مرنة للباقة الافتراضية (بالاسم أو بالرقم)
  var currentBundle = hiFindBundle(list, defaultBundleName);
  if (!currentBundle) {
    var q = hiQuota(defaultBundleName);
    if (!isNaN(q) && FEES_TABLE[q]) {
      currentBundle = { quota: q, price: NaN, bundleName: defaultBundleName };
    } else {
      console.error('[calc] Could not match default bundle "' + defaultBundleName + '" with:',
        list.map(function (b) { return b.bundleName; }));
    }
  }

  document.querySelector(".modal.show #desiredPackage").innerHTML = hiOptionsHtml(list, currentBundle).join('');

  var currentBundleName = currentPackage.split(',')[1].split(':')[1];
  document.querySelector(".modal.show #currentFixedInternet").value = currentBundleName;

  // CHANGED: بدل getElementById (كان ممكن يجيب عنصر من مكان تاني)
  var d = document.querySelector('.modal.show #desiredPackage');
  var c = document.querySelector('.modal.show #currentPackage');
  document.querySelector('.modal.show #submit-home-caluclator-button').disabled = !(d.value != '' && c.value != '');
}
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    document.getElementById('navigationToggelContent').style.visibility = 'visible';

    // Get the current URL path without hash
    let currentPath = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/(en|ar)\//, "/");; // Extracts only the path

    const links = document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-item');
    const togglerButton = document.querySelector('.toggler-button');
    let rtlActive = document.dir === 'rtl';

    let activeFound = false;

    links.forEach(link => {
        const anchor = link.querySelector('a');
        if (anchor && anchor.getAttribute('href')) {
            // Extract path from anchor href
            let anchorPath = new URL(anchor.href, window.location.origin).pathname;

            console.log("Anchor Path:", anchorPath, "Current Path:", currentPath);

            //if (currentPath === anchorPath) {
            if (currentPath.includes(anchorPath)) {
                link.classList.add('active');
                activeFound = true;
            } else {
                link.classList.remove('active');
            }
        } else {
            link.classList.remove('active');
        }
    });

    // If no active link is found, remove active class from toggler button
    if (!activeFound) {
        togglerButton.classList.remove('active');
    } else {
        if (links.length > 1 && links[1].classList.contains('active')) {
            togglerButton.classList.add('active');
        } else {
            togglerButton.classList.remove('active');
        }
    }

    // Toggle function
    togglerButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (rtlActive) currentPath = currentPath.replace('/ar', '');

        if (links.length > 1 && links[1].querySelector('a') && currentPath === new URL(links[1].querySelector('a').href, window.location.origin).pathname) {
            window.location.href = links[0].querySelector('a').href;
        } else if (links.length > 1 && links[0].querySelector('a')) {
            window.location.href = links[1].querySelector('a').href;
        }
    });

    // Handle smooth scroll to hash content
    function scrollToSection(hash) {
        const targetElement = document.getElementById(hash);
        if (targetElement) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            }, 300);
        }
    }

    if (window.location.hash) {
        scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
    }

    // Handle Liferay SPA navigation interference
    Liferay.on('endNavigate', function () {
        if (window.location.hash) {
            scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
        }
    });
});
</script>

function hoverdiv(e, divid, movement, content) {
    const rect = e.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = rect.left + rect.width + window.scrollX;
    const y = rect.top + window.scrollY;
    var div = document.getElementById(divid);
    div.style.left = x;
    div.style.top = y;
    if (movement == "over" && content.length > 55)
        div.style.visibility = "visible";
    else div.style.visibility = "hidden";
}

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    function scrollToSection(hash) {
        let targetElement = document.getElementById(hash.split('_tab')[0].split('#')[0])?.querySelector('.nav-link');
        console.log("Attempting to scroll to:", hash, targetElement);

        if (targetElement) {
            targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            setTimeout(()=> {
                document.querySelector('.we-multi-content-tab ').scrollIntoView({ behavior: "instant", block: "start"  });
            },100)
        } else {
            console.log("Element not found, waiting for it...");
            let observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
                let retryElement = document.getElementById(hash);
                if (retryElement) {
                    observer.disconnect();
                    retryElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            });

            observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        }
    }

    if (window.location.hash) {
        console.log("window.location.hash ->", window.location.hash);
        scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
    }

    Liferay.on('endNavigate', function () {
        if (window.location.hash) {
				
        console.log("window.location.hash - endNavigate ->", window.location.hash);
            scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
        }
    });
});

<p>مع WE Gold، استخدم رصيدك من الدقائق و الموبايل إنترنت بمرونة اكتر</p>

<ul>
	<li>الدقائق المحلية لشبكة WE أو للشبكات الأخرى تحاسب ب 1: 1.</li>
	<li>باقة الموبايل إنترنت تحاسب ب 1: 1</li>

	<li>لا يوجد باقة مخصصة للرسائل القصيرة وسيتم احتساب الرسالة من الدقائق (1 رسالة = 1 دقيقة).</li>

	<li>بمجرد إضافة خط لمجموعة العيلة قم بتحديد حد أقصى من الدقائق والموبايل جيجابيتس ليتمكن أفراد العيلة من الاستهلاك</li>

	<li>أيضاً يمكنك سداد جزء أو كل مصاريف الموبايل الخاصة بأفراد عيلتك.</li>

<p><strong><span class="f-24-m18" style="color:#5C2D91;">نقاط WE Bonus الشهرية:</span></strong></p>

<ul>

	<li>ستمنح كل باقة WE Gold نقاط مكافأة شهرية عند سداد الفاتورة الشهرية، باستثناء الضرائب والأقساط.</li>
	<li>يمكنك استبدال النقاط المجمعة بقيمة 5 جنيه لكل 100 نقطة فى فروع WE او من خلال شبكة شركاء WE Bonus</li>

	<li>يمكنك التعرف علي قائمه شبكه شركاء WE Bonus و معرفه تاريخ انتهاء صلاحية نقاطك من خلال تطبيق My WE</li>
	<li>جميع خدمات We Bonus و تصفح التطبيق متاحه داخل مصر فقط.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong><span class="f-24-m18" style="color:#5C2D91;">قسيمة شراء سنوية لأجهزة الموبايل</span></strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>بدءاً من WE Gold 600 ، ستحصل على قسيمة شراء سنوية لشراء أجهزة موبايل.</li>
	<li>القسيمة صالحة لمدة عام فقط.</li>

<p><strong><span class="f-24-m18" style="color:#5C2D91;">الإشتراك في الخط الأرضي</span></strong></p>

<ul>
	<li>مع WE Gold، استمتع بخدمة الخط الأرضي مع باقي خدمات باقتك في فاتورة واحدة.</li>
	<li>بدءًا من WE Gold 300، يمكنك الاشتراك في باقات WE Ardy (20، 35، 65) بمصاريف إضافية على الفاتورة الشهرية.</li>
	<li>بدءًا من WE Gold 1200، احصل على WE Ardy 20. و يمكنك أيضًا التحويل لباقة WE Ardy 35 ودفع 15 جنيه تضاف على الفاتورة الشهرية.</li>
	<li>تطبق جميع الشروط والاحكام الخاصة بتعاقد و توصيل خدمة الخط الأرضي.</li>
	<li>الإشتراك في الخط الأرضي اختياري لكل باقات WE Gold.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong><span class="f-24-m18" style="color:#5C2D91;">شروط عامة</span></strong></p>

	<li>يتحمل العميل جميع المصاريف التعاقدية و التشغيلية الخاصة بالإنترنت المنزلي أو WE Air و التليفون الأرضي.<span style="font-size:18px;"></span></li>
	<li> يحصل عملاء WE GOLD علي دقائق 140 الدليل بشكل شهري, وعند استهلاك هذه الدقائق بالكامل يتم احتساب أي استخدام إضافي بالسعر الاساسي و هو 1.50 جنيه للدقيقة.</li>

			<script>
var maxExceeded = false;
var maxFlag = false;
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    document.getElementById('handsetPriceInput')?.addEventListener("keypress", function(e) {
        if (e.key === "-" || e.key === "e") {
            e.preventDefault(); // block minus and scientific notation
        }
    });
    const modalEl = document.querySelector('.device_Installment');
    modalEl.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (!document.querySelector('.modal.fade.show.device_Installment')) {
                calculateInstallmentsAgain();
            }
        }, 10)
    });
});
function reset() {  
document.getElementById("downPaymentAmount").value='';
document.getElementById('downPayment').value='';
document.getElementById("installment_months").value='';
document.querySelector('.modal.show #extra_fees_row').style.display='none';
}
function calculateInstallement() {
    var amount = document.querySelector(".modal.show #downPaymentAmount").value.split(' ')[0];
		console.log(amount);
    var devicePrice = document.getElementById("handsetPriceInput").value;
    var extraFees = document.getElementById("installment_months").value.split(',')[1].split(':')[1];
    var remainingAmount = +devicePrice + +extraFees - +amount;
    var installmentMonths = +document.getElementById("installment_months").value.split(',')[0].split(':')[1];
    var result = remainingAmount / installmentMonths;
		
		 
    result = result.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("handsetPrice").innerHTML = devicePrice + " ";
    document.getElementById("result_downPayment").innerHTML = document.getElementById("downPayment").value + "%";
    document.getElementById("remaining_amounts").innerHTML = remainingAmount + " ";
    document.getElementById("installments_label").innerHTML = installmentMonths + " Months Installments";
    document.getElementById("installments_label_ar").innerHTML = "تقسيط " + installmentMonths + " شهر";
    document.getElementById("installments_value").innerHTML = document.dir=="rtl"?result + ' جنيه مصري / شهر ' : result + ' EGP/Month';
    var eligibility_prices = document.getElementById("eligibility_prices").innerHTML.replace((/  |\r\n|\n|\t|\r/gm), "").replace(" ", "").split(',').filter(x => x);
    var eligibility_plans = document.getElementById("eligibility_plans").innerHTML.replace((/  |\r\n|\n|\t|\r/gm), "").replace(" ", "").split(',').filter(x => x);
    console.log(eligibility_prices, eligibility_plans);
    var filtered_eligibility_plans = eligibility_plans.filter((plan, i) => {
        console.log(+remainingAmount, +eligibility_prices[i])
        if (+remainingAmount <= +eligibility_prices[i])
            return true;
        return false;
    });
    document.getElementById("eligibility_plans_result").innerHTML = filtered_eligibility_plans.join(',');
    document.getElementById('handsetPriceInput').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('downPayment').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('installment_months').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('submit-installment-caluclator-button').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('after-calculate-installments').style.display = "block";
    document.getElementById('before-calculate-installments').style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById('submit-installment-caluclator-button').disabled = true;
    if (screen.width < 768)
        {document.getElementById('installments-calculator-inputs-section').style.display = "none";
				document.getElementById('calc_again_mobile').style.display = "block";
				}
}
function calculateInstallmentsAgain() {
     document.querySelectorAll('#extra_fees_row').forEach(e=>e.style.display='none');
    document.getElementById('after-calculate-installments').style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById('before-calculate-installments').style.display = "flex";
		document.getElementById("max_error").style.display="none";
		 document.getElementById("min_error").style.display="none";
	  document.getElementById('handsetPriceInput').disabled = false;
	 document.getElementById('downPayment').disabled = false;
   document.getElementById('installment_months').disabled = false;
   document.getElementById('submit-installment-caluclator-button').disabled = true;
    if (screen.width < 1200)
       { document.getElementById('installments-calculator-inputs-section').style.display = "block";
			 document.getElementById('calc_again_mobile').style.display = "none";
			 }
			 document.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(e=>e.value ='');
	document.querySelectorAll('select').forEach(e=>e.value ='') ;
}
function selectDownPaymentAndDevicePrice(maxInput, minInput) {
    var handsetPriceInput = document.getElementById("handsetPriceInput").value;
		 maxInput = +maxInput.toString().replace(/\D/g, ".");
		 minInput = +minInput.toString().replace(/\D/g, ".");
		if(+handsetPriceInput > maxInput)
		{ 
		document.getElementById("max_error").style.display="block";
		 document.getElementById("min_error").style.display="none";
		minFlag = false;
		maxExceeded = true;
		}
		else if (+handsetPriceInput < minInput) {  
				document.getElementById("min_error").style.display="block";
				document.getElementById("max_error").style.display="none"
		minFlag = true;
		maxExceeded = false;
		}
		else {	document.getElementById("max_error").style.display="none"
		       maxExceeded=false;
					 document.getElementById("min_error").style.display="none"
		       minFlag=false;
		}
    var downPaymentInput = document.getElementById("downPayment").value;
    document.getElementById("downPaymentAmount").value = 
		document.dir=="rtl"?(handsetPriceInput * (downPaymentInput / 100)).toFixed(1) + ' جنيه مصري' : (handsetPriceInput * (downPaymentInput / 100)).toFixed(1) + ' EGP';
    if (!minFlag&&!maxExceeded &&document.getElementById('downPayment').value != '' && document.getElementById('downPaymentAmount').value != '' && document.getElementById("handsetPriceInput").value != '' &&
        document.getElementById("installment_months").value != "")
        document.getElementById('submit-installment-caluclator-button').disabled = false;
    else document.getElementById('submit-installment-caluclator-button').disabled = true;
}
function changeInstallmentMonths() {
    var extraFeesValue = document.querySelector(".modal.show #installment_months").value.split(',')[1].split(':')[1];  	
   	var extraFeesName = document.querySelector(".modal.show #installment_months").value?.split(',')[2].split(':')[1];
    console.log(extraFeesValue,extraFeesName)
	 if(!+extraFeesValue&&!extraFeesName)
		   document.querySelector('.modal.show #extra_fees_row').style.display='none';
			else document.querySelector('.modal.show #extra_fees_row').style.display = 'block';
            document.querySelector(".modal.show #Installment-extraFeesNameInput").innerHTML = extraFeesName;
            document.querySelector(".modal.show #InstallmentExtraFeesInput").value = extraFeesValue;
    if (!minFlag&&!maxExceeded &&document.getElementById('downPayment').value != '' && document.getElementById('downPaymentAmount').value != '' && document.getElementById("handsetPriceInput").value != '' &&
        document.querySelector(".modal.show #installment_months").value != "")
        document.querySelector(".modal.show #submit-installment-caluclator-button").disabled = false;
    else document.querySelector(".modal.show #submit-installment-caluclator-button").disabled = true;
}
$('#Device_Installment ').on('hidden.bs.modal ', function (event) {
    // do something...
    console.log('close');
})

function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}

let comparison_citeria=""
function testGetContentAPI(tokenId) {
  const token = tokenId;

  const url = '/o/c/comparisoncriterias/';

  
fetch(url, {
  method: 'GET',
  credentials: 'include',
  mode: 'same-origin',
  headers: {
    'Accept': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
  }
})
  .then(response => {
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Network response was not ok: ' + response.status);
    }
    return response.json();
  })
  .then(data => {
    comparison_citeria = data.items?.map(i => {
      return { segment: i.segment, criteria: i.criteria?.key };
    });
  })
  .catch(error => {
    console.error('Fetch Error:', error);
  });
}
function getAccessToken() {
  var clientId = 'id-528c6c12-59bc-fa54-83ae-b64d80d2475c';         
  var clientSecret = 'secret-dbecaf1e-754e-1721-6b9b-a7abbb431dd'; 
  var tokenUrl = '/o/oauth2/token';


  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Authorization': 'Basic ' + btoa(clientId+":"+clientSecret)
  };

  const body = new URLSearchParams();
  body.append('grant_type', 'client_credentials');

  fetch(tokenUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: headers,
    body: body
  })
    .then(response => {

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Token request failed: ' + response.status);
      }
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
      const token = data.access_token;

      testGetContentAPI(token);
    })
    .catch(error => {
		
      console.error('Error getting access token:', error);
    });
}

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var fotterItems = document.querySelectorAll('.footer_container .expandable_item');
        fotterItems.forEach(function (item) { 
            var child = item.children[0];
            if (item.id == ("footer_" + element)) {
                if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-show');
                    child.classList.add('we-hide');
                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                } else {
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                }
            } else if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

let comparison_citeria=""
function testGetContentAPI(tokenId) {
  const token = tokenId;

  const url = '/o/c/comparisoncriterias/';

  
fetch(url, {
  method: 'GET',
  credentials: 'include',
  mode: 'same-origin',
  headers: {
    'Accept': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
  }
})
  .then(response => {
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Network response was not ok: ' + response.status);
    }
    return response.json();
  })
  .then(data => {
    comparison_citeria = data.items?.map(i => {
      return { segment: i.segment, criteria: i.criteria?.key };
    });
  })
  .catch(error => {
    console.error('Fetch Error:', error);
  });
}
function getAccessToken() {
  var clientId = 'id-528c6c12-59bc-fa54-83ae-b64d80d2475c';         
  var clientSecret = 'secret-dbecaf1e-754e-1721-6b9b-a7abbb431dd'; 
  var tokenUrl = '/o/oauth2/token';


  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Authorization': 'Basic ' + btoa(clientId+":"+clientSecret)
  };

  const body = new URLSearchParams();
  body.append('grant_type', 'client_credentials');

  fetch(tokenUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: headers,
    body: body
  })
    .then(response => {

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Token request failed: ' + response.status);
      }
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
      const token = data.access_token;

      testGetContentAPI(token);
    })
    .catch(error => {
		
      console.error('Error getting access token:', error);
    });
}

    function toggleExpand(event, element) {
        if (event.target.closest('a')) {
            return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var fotterItems = document.querySelectorAll('.footer_container .expandable_item');
        fotterItems.forEach(function (item) { 
            var child = item.children[0];
            if (item.id == ("footer_" + element)) {
                if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-show');
                    child.classList.add('we-hide');
                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                } else {
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                }
            } else if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                child.classList.remove('we-show');
                child.classList.add('we-hide');
            }
        });
    }

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

function testGetContentAPI(tokenId) {
  const token = tokenId;

  const url = '/o/c/comparisoncriterias/';

  
fetch(url, {
  method: 'GET',
  credentials: 'include',
  mode: 'same-origin',
  headers: {
    'Accept': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
  }
})
  .then(response => {
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Network response was not ok: ' + response.status);
    }
    return response.json();
  })
  .then(data => {
    comparison_citeria = data.items?.map(i => {
      return { segment: i.segment, criteria: i.criteria?.key };
    });
  })
  .catch(error => {
    console.error('Fetch Error:', error);
  });
}

            } else if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}

function testGetContentAPI(tokenId) {
  const token = tokenId;

  const url = '/o/c/comparisoncriterias/';

  
fetch(url, {
  method: 'GET',
  credentials: 'include',
  mode: 'same-origin',
  headers: {
    'Accept': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
  }
})
  .then(response => {
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Network response was not ok: ' + response.status);
    }
    return response.json();
  })
  .then(data => {
    comparison_citeria = data.items?.map(i => {
      return { segment: i.segment, criteria: i.criteria?.key };
    });
  })
  .catch(error => {
    console.error('Fetch Error:', error);
  });
}

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

    function toggleExpand(event, element) {
        if (event.target.closest('a')) {
            return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var fotterItems = document.querySelectorAll('.footer_container .expandable_item');
        fotterItems.forEach(function (item) { 
            var child = item.children[0];
            if (item.id == ("footer_" + element)) {
                if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-show');
                    child.classList.add('we-hide');
                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                } else {
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                }
            } else if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                child.classList.remove('we-show');
                child.classList.add('we-hide');
            }
        });
    }

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

    function toggleExpand(event, element) {
        if (event.target.closest('a')) {
            return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var fotterItems = document.querySelectorAll('.footer_container .expandable_item');
        fotterItems.forEach(function (item) { 
            var child = item.children[0];
            if (item.id == ("footer_" + element)) {
                if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-show');
                    child.classList.add('we-hide');
                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                } else {
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                }
            } else if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                child.classList.remove('we-show');
                child.classList.add('we-hide');
            }
        });
    }

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}

    function toggleExpand(event, element) {
        if (event.target.closest('a')) {
            return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var fotterItems = document.querySelectorAll('.footer_container .expandable_item');
        fotterItems.forEach(function (item) { 
            var child = item.children[0];
            if (item.id == ("footer_" + element)) {
                if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-show');
                    child.classList.add('we-hide');
                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                } else {
                    child.classList.add('we-show');
                }
            } else if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                child.classList.remove('we-show');
                child.classList.add('we-hide');
            }
        });
    }

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>
