function onDropdownChange() {
	console.log("test")
    const dropdown = document.querySelector("#sort-by"); // Dropdown element
    const cardsContainer = document.querySelector(".we-cards-container > .row"); // The row containing the cards
  if(cardsContainer != null)
	{	const cards = Array.from(cardsContainer.querySelectorAll(".we-service-card")); // All individual cards

    const criteria = dropdown.value; // Get the selected sort option

    // Sorting logic
    const sortedCards = cards.sort((a, b) => {
        if (criteria === "Low To High") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceA !== null ? priceA : Infinity) - (priceB !== null ? priceB : Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "High To Low") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceB !== null ? priceB : -Infinity) - (priceA !== null ? priceA : -Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "Manufacturer") {
            const manufacturerA = getManufacturer(a).toLowerCase();
            const manufacturerB = getManufacturer(b).toLowerCase();

            // Prioritize cards with manufacturer values over empty fields
            if (!manufacturerA && manufacturerB) return 1; // Move empty fields to the bottom
            if (manufacturerA && !manufacturerB) return -1; // Move non-empty fields to the top

            return manufacturerA.localeCompare(manufacturerB); // Sort alphabetically
        } else if (criteria === "Newest") {
            const dateA = getDate(a);
            const dateB = getDate(b);
					  console.log("inside sort newest",dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0)
            return (dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0); // Newest first
        }
        return 0; // Default case for "Select"
    });

    // Clear and re-append sorted cards
    cardsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    sortedCards.forEach((card) => cardsContainer.appendChild(card));
	}
}

// Helper function to get the price from a card, handling missing or empty prices
function getPrice(card) {
    const priceElements = card.querySelectorAll(".choose-plan-price-quantity");
	
    const validPriceElement = Array.from(priceElements).find((priceElement) => {
        return  !priceElement.querySelector(".price-line-through") && priceElement.textContent.trim() !== "";
    });

    // Extract and return the price as a float, or return null if no valid price is found
    return validPriceElement ? parseFloat(validPriceElement.textContent.trim()) : null;
}

// Helper function to get the manufacturer from a card, handling missing or empty values
function getManufacturer(card) {
    const manufacturerElement = card.querySelector(".manufacturer");
    return manufacturerElement && manufacturerElement.textContent.trim() !== "" 
        ? manufacturerElement.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() 
        : ""; // Return an empty string for missing/empty manufacturers
}

// Helper function to get the date from a card
function getDate(card) {
    const dateElement = card.querySelector(".display-date");
    if (!dateElement || dateElement.textContent.trim() === "") return null; // Return null if no date is found
    const dateString = dateElement.textContent.trim();
    return new Date(dateString); // Convert date string to Date object
}

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

function onDropdownChange() {
	console.log("test")
    const dropdown = document.querySelector("#sort-by"); // Dropdown element
    const cardsContainer = document.querySelector(".we-cards-container > .row"); // The row containing the cards
  if(cardsContainer != null)
	{	const cards = Array.from(cardsContainer.querySelectorAll(".we-service-card")); // All individual cards

    const criteria = dropdown.value; // Get the selected sort option

    // Sorting logic
    const sortedCards = cards.sort((a, b) => {
        if (criteria === "Low To High") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceA !== null ? priceA : Infinity) - (priceB !== null ? priceB : Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "High To Low") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceB !== null ? priceB : -Infinity) - (priceA !== null ? priceA : -Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "Manufacturer") {
            const manufacturerA = getManufacturer(a).toLowerCase();
            const manufacturerB = getManufacturer(b).toLowerCase();

            // Prioritize cards with manufacturer values over empty fields
            if (!manufacturerA && manufacturerB) return 1; // Move empty fields to the bottom
            if (manufacturerA && !manufacturerB) return -1; // Move non-empty fields to the top

            return manufacturerA.localeCompare(manufacturerB); // Sort alphabetically
        } else if (criteria === "Newest") {
            const dateA = getDate(a);
            const dateB = getDate(b);
					  console.log("inside sort newest",dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0)
            return (dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0); // Newest first
        }
        return 0; // Default case for "Select"
    });

    // Clear and re-append sorted cards
    cardsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    sortedCards.forEach((card) => cardsContainer.appendChild(card));
	}
}

// Helper function to get the price from a card, handling missing or empty prices
function getPrice(card) {
    const priceElements = card.querySelectorAll(".choose-plan-price-quantity");
	
    const validPriceElement = Array.from(priceElements).find((priceElement) => {
        return  !priceElement.querySelector(".price-line-through") && priceElement.textContent.trim() !== "";
    });

    // Extract and return the price as a float, or return null if no valid price is found
    return validPriceElement ? parseFloat(validPriceElement.textContent.trim()) : null;
}

// Helper function to get the manufacturer from a card, handling missing or empty values
function getManufacturer(card) {
    const manufacturerElement = card.querySelector(".manufacturer");
    return manufacturerElement && manufacturerElement.textContent.trim() !== "" 
        ? manufacturerElement.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() 
        : ""; // Return an empty string for missing/empty manufacturers
}

// Helper function to get the date from a card
function getDate(card) {
    const dateElement = card.querySelector(".display-date");
    if (!dateElement || dateElement.textContent.trim() === "") return null; // Return null if no date is found
    const dateString = dateElement.textContent.trim();
    return new Date(dateString); // Convert date string to Date object
}

function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}

function onDropdownChange() {
	console.log("test")
    const dropdown = document.querySelector("#sort-by"); // Dropdown element
    const cardsContainer = document.querySelector(".we-cards-container > .row"); // The row containing the cards
  if(cardsContainer != null)
	{	const cards = Array.from(cardsContainer.querySelectorAll(".we-service-card")); // All individual cards

    const criteria = dropdown.value; // Get the selected sort option

    // Sorting logic
    const sortedCards = cards.sort((a, b) => {
        if (criteria === "Low To High") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceA !== null ? priceA : Infinity) - (priceB !== null ? priceB : Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "High To Low") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceB !== null ? priceB : -Infinity) - (priceA !== null ? priceA : -Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "Manufacturer") {
            const manufacturerA = getManufacturer(a).toLowerCase();
            const manufacturerB = getManufacturer(b).toLowerCase();

            // Prioritize cards with manufacturer values over empty fields
            if (!manufacturerA && manufacturerB) return 1; // Move empty fields to the bottom
            if (manufacturerA && !manufacturerB) return -1; // Move non-empty fields to the top

            return manufacturerA.localeCompare(manufacturerB); // Sort alphabetically
        } else if (criteria === "Newest") {
            const dateA = getDate(a);
            const dateB = getDate(b);
					  console.log("inside sort newest",dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0)
            return (dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0); // Newest first
        }
        return 0; // Default case for "Select"
    });

    // Clear and re-append sorted cards
    cardsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    sortedCards.forEach((card) => cardsContainer.appendChild(card));
	}
}

// Helper function to get the price from a card, handling missing or empty prices
function getPrice(card) {
    const priceElements = card.querySelectorAll(".choose-plan-price-quantity");
	
    const validPriceElement = Array.from(priceElements).find((priceElement) => {
        return  !priceElement.querySelector(".price-line-through") && priceElement.textContent.trim() !== "";
    });

    // Extract and return the price as a float, or return null if no valid price is found
    return validPriceElement ? parseFloat(validPriceElement.textContent.trim()) : null;
}

// Helper function to get the manufacturer from a card, handling missing or empty values
function getManufacturer(card) {
    const manufacturerElement = card.querySelector(".manufacturer");
    return manufacturerElement && manufacturerElement.textContent.trim() !== "" 
        ? manufacturerElement.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() 
        : ""; // Return an empty string for missing/empty manufacturers
}

// Helper function to get the date from a card
function getDate(card) {
    const dateElement = card.querySelector(".display-date");
    if (!dateElement || dateElement.textContent.trim() === "") return null; // Return null if no date is found
    const dateString = dateElement.textContent.trim();
    return new Date(dateString); // Convert date string to Date object
}

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

            if (!manufacturerA && manufacturerB) return 1; // Move empty fields to the bottom

            return manufacturerA.localeCompare(manufacturerB); // Sort alphabetically

// Helper function to get the price from a card, handling missing or empty prices
function getPrice(card) {
    const priceElements = card.querySelectorAll(".choose-plan-price-quantity");
	
    const validPriceElement = Array.from(priceElements).find((priceElement) => {
        return  !priceElement.querySelector(".price-line-through") && priceElement.textContent.trim() !== "";
    });

    // Extract and return the price as a float, or return null if no valid price is found
    return validPriceElement ? parseFloat(validPriceElement.textContent.trim()) : null;
}

function getDate(card) {

}

        // If the node has childNodes, traverse them recursively
        if (Array.isArray(node.childNodes)) {
            for (let child of node.childNodes) {
                traverse(child);
            }
        }
    }

    // Start the search from the root node
    traverse(tree);
console.log('result: ',result);

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

function onDropdownChange() {
	console.log("test")
    const dropdown = document.querySelector("#sort-by"); // Dropdown element
    const cardsContainer = document.querySelector(".we-cards-container > .row"); // The row containing the cards
  if(cardsContainer != null)
	{	const cards = Array.from(cardsContainer.querySelectorAll(".we-service-card")); // All individual cards

    const criteria = dropdown.value; // Get the selected sort option

    // Sorting logic
    const sortedCards = cards.sort((a, b) => {
        if (criteria === "Low To High") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceA !== null ? priceA : Infinity) - (priceB !== null ? priceB : Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "High To Low") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceB !== null ? priceB : -Infinity) - (priceA !== null ? priceA : -Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "Manufacturer") {
            const manufacturerA = getManufacturer(a).toLowerCase();
            const manufacturerB = getManufacturer(b).toLowerCase();

            // Prioritize cards with manufacturer values over empty fields
            if (!manufacturerA && manufacturerB) return 1; // Move empty fields to the bottom
            if (manufacturerA && !manufacturerB) return -1; // Move non-empty fields to the top

            return manufacturerA.localeCompare(manufacturerB); // Sort alphabetically
        } else if (criteria === "Newest") {
            const dateA = getDate(a);
            const dateB = getDate(b);
					  console.log("inside sort newest",dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0)
            return (dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0); // Newest first
        }
        return 0; // Default case for "Select"
    });

    // Clear and re-append sorted cards
    cardsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    sortedCards.forEach((card) => cardsContainer.appendChild(card));
	}
}

// Helper function to get the price from a card, handling missing or empty prices
function getPrice(card) {
    const priceElements = card.querySelectorAll(".choose-plan-price-quantity");
	
    const validPriceElement = Array.from(priceElements).find((priceElement) => {
        return  !priceElement.querySelector(".price-line-through") && priceElement.textContent.trim() !== "";
    });

    // Extract and return the price as a float, or return null if no valid price is found
    return validPriceElement ? parseFloat(validPriceElement.textContent.trim()) : null;
}

// Helper function to get the manufacturer from a card, handling missing or empty values
function getManufacturer(card) {
    const manufacturerElement = card.querySelector(".manufacturer");
    return manufacturerElement && manufacturerElement.textContent.trim() !== "" 
        ? manufacturerElement.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() 
        : ""; // Return an empty string for missing/empty manufacturers
}

// Helper function to get the date from a card
function getDate(card) {
    const dateElement = card.querySelector(".display-date");
    if (!dateElement || dateElement.textContent.trim() === "") return null; // Return null if no date is found
    const dateString = dateElement.textContent.trim();
    return new Date(dateString); // Convert date string to Date object
}

            return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var fotterItems = document.querySelectorAll('.footer_container .expandable_item');
        fotterItems.forEach(function (item) { 
            var child = item.children[0];
            if (item.id == ("footer_" + element)) {
                if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-show');

                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {

                }
            } else if (child.classList.contains('we-show')) {
                child.classList.remove('we-show');

            }

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

function onDropdownChange() {
	console.log("test")
    const dropdown = document.querySelector("#sort-by"); // Dropdown element
    const cardsContainer = document.querySelector(".we-cards-container > .row"); // The row containing the cards
  if(cardsContainer != null)
	{	const cards = Array.from(cardsContainer.querySelectorAll(".we-service-card")); // All individual cards

    const criteria = dropdown.value; // Get the selected sort option

    // Sorting logic
    const sortedCards = cards.sort((a, b) => {
        if (criteria === "Low To High") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceA !== null ? priceA : Infinity) - (priceB !== null ? priceB : Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "High To Low") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceB !== null ? priceB : -Infinity) - (priceA !== null ? priceA : -Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "Manufacturer") {
            const manufacturerA = getManufacturer(a).toLowerCase();
            const manufacturerB = getManufacturer(b).toLowerCase();

            // Prioritize cards with manufacturer values over empty fields
            if (!manufacturerA && manufacturerB) return 1; // Move empty fields to the bottom
            if (manufacturerA && !manufacturerB) return -1; // Move non-empty fields to the top

            return manufacturerA.localeCompare(manufacturerB); // Sort alphabetically
        } else if (criteria === "Newest") {
            const dateA = getDate(a);
            const dateB = getDate(b);
					  console.log("inside sort newest",dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0)
            return (dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0); // Newest first
        }
        return 0; // Default case for "Select"
    });

    // Clear and re-append sorted cards
    cardsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    sortedCards.forEach((card) => cardsContainer.appendChild(card));
	}
}

// Helper function to get the price from a card, handling missing or empty prices
function getPrice(card) {
    const priceElements = card.querySelectorAll(".choose-plan-price-quantity");
	
    const validPriceElement = Array.from(priceElements).find((priceElement) => {
        return  !priceElement.querySelector(".price-line-through") && priceElement.textContent.trim() !== "";
    });

    // Extract and return the price as a float, or return null if no valid price is found
    return validPriceElement ? parseFloat(validPriceElement.textContent.trim()) : null;
}

// Helper function to get the manufacturer from a card, handling missing or empty values
function getManufacturer(card) {
    const manufacturerElement = card.querySelector(".manufacturer");
    return manufacturerElement && manufacturerElement.textContent.trim() !== "" 
        ? manufacturerElement.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() 
        : ""; // Return an empty string for missing/empty manufacturers
}

// Helper function to get the date from a card
function getDate(card) {
    const dateElement = card.querySelector(".display-date");
    if (!dateElement || dateElement.textContent.trim() === "") return null; // Return null if no date is found
    const dateString = dateElement.textContent.trim();
    return new Date(dateString); // Convert date string to Date object
}

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    document.getElementById('navigationToggelContent').style.visibility = 'visible';

    let currentPath = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/(en|ar)\//, "/");; // Extracts only the path

    const links = document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-item');
    const togglerButton = document.querySelector('.toggler-button');
    let rtlActive = document.dir === 'rtl';

    let activeFound = false;

    links.forEach(link => {
        const anchor = link.querySelector('a');
        if (anchor && anchor.getAttribute('href')) {
            // Extract path from anchor href
            let anchorPath = new URL(anchor.href, window.location.origin).pathname;

            console.log("Anchor Path:", anchorPath, "Current Path:", currentPath);

            //if (currentPath === anchorPath) {
            if (currentPath.includes(anchorPath)) {
                link.classList.add('active');
                activeFound = true;
            } else {
                link.classList.remove('active');
            }
        } else {
            link.classList.remove('active');
        }
    });

    // If no active link is found, remove active class from toggler button
    if (!activeFound) {
        togglerButton.classList.remove('active');
    } else {
        if (links.length > 1 && links[1].classList.contains('active')) {
            togglerButton.classList.add('active');
        } else {
            togglerButton.classList.remove('active');
        }
    }

    // Toggle function
    togglerButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (rtlActive) currentPath = currentPath.replace('/ar', '');

        if (links.length > 1 && links[1].querySelector('a') && currentPath === new URL(links[1].querySelector('a').href, window.location.origin).pathname) {
            window.location.href = links[0].querySelector('a').href;
        } else if (links.length > 1 && links[0].querySelector('a')) {
            window.location.href = links[1].querySelector('a').href;
        }
    });

    // Handle smooth scroll to hash content
    function scrollToSection(hash) {
        const targetElement = document.getElementById(hash);
        if (targetElement) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            }, 300);
        }
    }

    if (window.location.hash) {
        scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
    }

    // Handle Liferay SPA navigation interference
    Liferay.on('endNavigate', function () {
        if (window.location.hash) {
            scrollToSection(window.location.hash.substring(1));
        }
    });
});

function onDropdownChange() {
	console.log("test")
    const dropdown = document.querySelector("#sort-by"); // Dropdown element
    const cardsContainer = document.querySelector(".we-cards-container > .row"); // The row containing the cards
  if(cardsContainer != null)
	{	const cards = Array.from(cardsContainer.querySelectorAll(".we-service-card")); // All individual cards

    const criteria = dropdown.value; // Get the selected sort option

    // Sorting logic
    const sortedCards = cards.sort((a, b) => {
        if (criteria === "Low To High") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceA !== null ? priceA : Infinity) - (priceB !== null ? priceB : Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "High To Low") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceB !== null ? priceB : -Infinity) - (priceA !== null ? priceA : -Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "Manufacturer") {
            const manufacturerA = getManufacturer(a).toLowerCase();
            const manufacturerB = getManufacturer(b).toLowerCase();

            // Prioritize cards with manufacturer values over empty fields
            if (!manufacturerA && manufacturerB) return 1; // Move empty fields to the bottom
            if (manufacturerA && !manufacturerB) return -1; // Move non-empty fields to the top

            return manufacturerA.localeCompare(manufacturerB); // Sort alphabetically
        } else if (criteria === "Newest") {
            const dateA = getDate(a);
            const dateB = getDate(b);
					  console.log("inside sort newest",dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0)
            return (dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0); // Newest first
        }
        return 0; // Default case for "Select"
    });

    // Clear and re-append sorted cards
    cardsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    sortedCards.forEach((card) => cardsContainer.appendChild(card));
	}
}

// Helper function to get the price from a card, handling missing or empty prices
function getPrice(card) {
    const priceElements = card.querySelectorAll(".choose-plan-price-quantity");
	
    const validPriceElement = Array.from(priceElements).find((priceElement) => {
        return  !priceElement.querySelector(".price-line-through") && priceElement.textContent.trim() !== "";
    });

    // Extract and return the price as a float, or return null if no valid price is found
    return validPriceElement ? parseFloat(validPriceElement.textContent.trim()) : null;
}

// Helper function to get the manufacturer from a card, handling missing or empty values
function getManufacturer(card) {
    const manufacturerElement = card.querySelector(".manufacturer");
    return manufacturerElement && manufacturerElement.textContent.trim() !== "" 
        ? manufacturerElement.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() 
        : ""; // Return an empty string for missing/empty manufacturers
}

// Helper function to get the date from a card
function getDate(card) {
    const dateElement = card.querySelector(".display-date");
    if (!dateElement || dateElement.textContent.trim() === "") return null; // Return null if no date is found
    const dateString = dateElement.textContent.trim();
    return new Date(dateString); // Convert date string to Date object
}

                    child.classList.remove('we-show');

                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');

                }

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

function onDropdownChange() {
	console.log("test")
    const dropdown = document.querySelector("#sort-by"); // Dropdown element
    const cardsContainer = document.querySelector(".we-cards-container > .row"); // The row containing the cards
  if(cardsContainer != null)
	{	const cards = Array.from(cardsContainer.querySelectorAll(".we-service-card")); // All individual cards

    const criteria = dropdown.value; // Get the selected sort option

    // Sorting logic
    const sortedCards = cards.sort((a, b) => {
        if (criteria === "Low To High") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceA !== null ? priceA : Infinity) - (priceB !== null ? priceB : Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "High To Low") {
            const priceA = getPrice(a);
            const priceB = getPrice(b);
            return (priceB !== null ? priceB : -Infinity) - (priceA !== null ? priceA : -Infinity);
        } else if (criteria === "Manufacturer") {
            const manufacturerA = getManufacturer(a).toLowerCase();
            const manufacturerB = getManufacturer(b).toLowerCase();

            // Prioritize cards with manufacturer values over empty fields
            if (!manufacturerA && manufacturerB) return 1; // Move empty fields to the bottom
            if (manufacturerA && !manufacturerB) return -1; // Move non-empty fields to the top

            return manufacturerA.localeCompare(manufacturerB); // Sort alphabetically
        } else if (criteria === "Newest") {
            const dateA = getDate(a);
            const dateB = getDate(b);
					  console.log("inside sort newest",dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0)
            return (dateB ? dateB.getTime() : 0) - (dateA ? dateA.getTime() : 0); // Newest first
        }
        return 0; // Default case for "Select"
    });

    // Clear and re-append sorted cards
    cardsContainer.innerHTML = "";
    sortedCards.forEach((card) => cardsContainer.appendChild(card));
	}
}

// Helper function to get the price from a card, handling missing or empty prices
function getPrice(card) {
    const priceElements = card.querySelectorAll(".choose-plan-price-quantity");
	
    const validPriceElement = Array.from(priceElements).find((priceElement) => {
        return  !priceElement.querySelector(".price-line-through") && priceElement.textContent.trim() !== "";
    });

    // Extract and return the price as a float, or return null if no valid price is found
    return validPriceElement ? parseFloat(validPriceElement.textContent.trim()) : null;
}

// Helper function to get the manufacturer from a card, handling missing or empty values
function getManufacturer(card) {
    const manufacturerElement = card.querySelector(".manufacturer");
    return manufacturerElement && manufacturerElement.textContent.trim() !== "" 
        ? manufacturerElement.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() 
        : ""; // Return an empty string for missing/empty manufacturers
}

// Helper function to get the date from a card
function getDate(card) {
    const dateElement = card.querySelector(".display-date");
    if (!dateElement || dateElement.textContent.trim() === "") return null; // Return null if no date is found
    const dateString = dateElement.textContent.trim();
    return new Date(dateString); // Convert date string to Date object
}

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

            return;

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var fotterItems = document.querySelectorAll('.footer_container .expandable_item');
        fotterItems.forEach(function (item) { 
            var child = item.children[0];
            if (item.id == ("footer_" + element)) {

                    child.classList.remove('we-show');

                } else if (child.classList.contains('we-hide')) {
                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');

                }

            }

	function getValueByAttribute(node, attr) {

				);
			}
			else if (

			) {

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}

  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank';

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}

                    child.classList.remove('we-show');

                    child.classList.remove('we-hide');

                }

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

<script>
function closeIframePopup() {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // stop loading and hide everything
	iframe.src = 'about:blank'; 
  spinner.style.display = 'none';
  overlay.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
	document.documentElement.classList.remove('link_popup_open');
}

function openIframePopup(url) {
  const iframe  = document.getElementById('link_popupFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('link_popup_overlay');
  const spinner = document.getElementById('link_popup_spinner');

  // show overlay + spinner first
  overlay.style.display = 'block';
  spinner.style.display = 'block';
	iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.classList.add('link_popup_open');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('link_popup_open');

  // clear any previous handlers
  iframe.onload = null;
  iframe.onerror = null;

  iframe.addEventListener('load', function onLoad() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
		iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
		let doc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    const anchors = doc.querySelectorAll('a[onclick*="openIframePopup"]');
    anchors.forEach(a => {
      a.removeAttribute('onclick');
      a.onclick = null;
    });
  });

  iframe.addEventListener('error', function onErr() {
    spinner.style.display = 'none';
			iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
  });

  // now set the URL
  iframe.src = url;

  return false;
}
</script>

                                                    <div style="font-size:16px; line-height:1.8; direction:rtl; text-align:right; word-break:break-word; overflow-wrap:break-word; color:#000;">
  <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0; font-size:16px; line-height:1.8; color:#7B4CC2; text-decoration:underline; font-weight:bold;">خدمة استقبال الحوالات الدولية متاحة الآن على محفظة WE Pay.</p>

  <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0; font-size:16px; line-height:1.8; color:#000;">دلوقتي تقدر تستقبل حوالتك الدولية من الخارج على محفظة WE Pay في نفس اللحظة.</p>

  <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0; font-size:16px; line-height:1.8; color:#000;"><strong>خطوات تحويل الأموال</strong></p>

  <ul dir="rtl" style="margin:0 0 16px 0; padding-right:22px; padding-left:0; font-size:16px; line-height:1.8; color:#000;">
    <li style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#000;">يقوم المرسل بزيارة أقرب مقدمي خدمة التحويلات الدولية المتوفر لديها خدمة تحويل الأموال للمحافظ.</li>
    <li style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#000;">يقوم المرسل بإبلاغ الوكيل برقم محفظة WE Pay بشكل صحيح.</li>
    <li style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#000;">يستقبل عميل WE Pay الأموال على محفظته في نفس اللحظة.</li>
  </ul>

  <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0; font-size:16px; line-height:1.8; color:#000;"><strong>الشروط والأحكام</strong></p>

  <ul dir="rtl" style="margin:0 0 16px 0; padding-right:22px; padding-left:0; font-size:16px; line-height:1.8; color:#000;">
    <li style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#000;">يتم استقبال الحوالة الدولية على محفظة WE Pay في نفس اللحظة.</li>
    <li style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#000;">التحويلات المالية الدولية على محفظة WE Pay متاحة من خلال مقدمي خدمة التحويلات الدولية حول العالم.</li>
    <li style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#000;">يجب أن تكون محفظة WE Pay نشطة لاستقبال الحوالة.</li>
    <li style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#000;">سيتم إضافة المبلغ المحول على محفظة WE Pay بالجنيه المصري.</li>
    <li style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#000;">لا يوجد رسوم على الخدمة.</li>
  </ul>
</div>

                    <div class="f-18-m14">
<p><strong>أ‌. المحافظ الحالية </strong></p>

<ul dir="rtl">
	<li>الحد الأقصى للتعاملات اليومية 60,000 جنيه مصري.</li>
	<li>الحد الأقصى للتعاملات الشهرية 200,000 جنيه مصري.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>ب‌. المحافظ الجديدة التى تم الاشتراك بها (بداية من 6 مايو 2025)</strong></p>

<ul dir="rtl">
	<li>الحد الأقصى اليومى 10,000 جنيه مصري.</li>
	<li>الحد الأقصى الشهرى 60,000 جنيه مصري.
	<ul>
		<li>بعد مرور 90 يومًا من تاريخ اشتراكك بالخدمة، سيتم تحديث الحدود اليومية والشهرية لمحفظتك لتتطابق مع الحدود المعتمدة للمحافظ الحالية الأخرى.</li>
		<li>للاحتفاظ بمحفظتك مفعلة، يجب التأكد من استخدامها خلال 90 يومًا في إجراء معاملة مالية (وخاصة المعاملات التي تتضمن خصمًا من الرصيد، مثل )إرسال الأموال أو سداد الفواتير)، أو في إجراء أو استقبال مكالمة صوتية.</li>
		<li>خلال أول 90 يومًا، لا يمكن استخدام المحفظة إلا من خلال نفس جهاز الهاتف المحمول الذي تم الاشتراك من خلاله وتثبيت التطبيق عليه. و في حال رغبتك في تغيير الجهاز، يُرجى زيارة أقرب فرع من فروع WE لتحديث بياناتك و تشغيل المحفظة علي الجهاز الجديد </li>
	</ul>
	</li>
</ul>

                    <ol class="f-18-m14" dir="rtl">
	<li><strong>ماهى عدد المحافظ الإلكترونية التى يمكن الحصول عليها ؟</strong>
	<p>يمكنك الحصول على 3 محافظ لــ 3 أرقام مختلفة لنفس بطاقة الرقم القومى.</p>
	</li>
	<br />
	<li><strong>ماهو السن القانوني للإشترك فى محفظة WE Pay ؟</strong>
	<p>يمكنك الأشتراك فى محفظة WE Pay عند بلوغ سن 15 عاما.</p>
	</li>
	<br />
	<li><strong>ما هو رقم خدمة عملاء محفظة WE Pay ؟</strong>
	<p>في حالة وجود شكوى أو أي استفسار اتصل بخدمة عملاء <bdi>565 WE Pay </bdi></p>
	</li>
	<li><strong>كيف يمكن تغيير الرقم السرى الخاص بمحفظة WE Pay ؟</strong>
	<ul>
		<li>بعد الدخول إلى التطبيق بكلمة المرور الحالية، قم باختيار "تغيير Pin-M "من الإعدادات .</li>
		<li>أدخل الرقم السري الحالي.</li>
		<li>أدخل الرقم السرى الجديد ( مرتين للتأكيد ).</li>
	</ul>
	</li>
	<br />
	<li><strong>ما هو كود محفظة WE Pay ؟</strong>
	<p><bdi>*7#</bdi> ويمكنك من خلاله إدارة حساب محفظة <bdi>WE Pay</bdi> وإجراء العديد من المعاملات المالية.</p>

<script>
      let carouselInstance = null;

      function waitForCardContent(container) {
        const images = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("img"))
          .filter((img) => !img.complete)
          .map(
            (img) =>
              new Promise((resolve) => {
                img.onload = resolve;
                img.onerror = resolve;
              })
          );
        return Promise.all(images);
      }
      let tallestSlideHeight = null;

      function updateArrowStates() {
        if (!carouselInstance) return;
        const carousel = document.getElementById("services-carousel");
        const slides = carousel.querySelectorAll(".carousel-item");
        const prevBtn = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-control-prev");
        const nextBtn = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-control-next");

        const activeIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex((slide) =>
          slide.classList.contains("active")
        );

        const isRTL = document.documentElement.dir === "rtl";

        if (!isRTL) {
          prevBtn.classList.toggle("disabled", activeIndex === 0);
          nextBtn.classList.toggle(
            "disabled",
            activeIndex === slides.length - 1
          );
        } else {
          prevBtn.classList.toggle(
            "disabled",
            activeIndex === slides.length - 1
          );
          nextBtn.classList.toggle("disabled", activeIndex === 0);
        }
      }

      function enableCarousel() {
        if (carouselInstance) return;
        const container = document.querySelector(".services");
        if (!container) return;
        container.classList.add("d-none");
        const serviceCols = document.querySelectorAll(
          "#services-root .row.services .col-md-6"
        );
        serviceCols.forEach((col) => {
          col.classList.remove( "mb-4");

          
        });
        waitForCardContent(container).then(() => {
          const carousel = document.getElementById("services-carousel");
          const inner = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-inner");
          const indicators = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-indicators");

          inner.innerHTML = "";
          indicators.innerHTML = "";

          const items = Array.from(container.children);

          items.forEach((item, index) => {
            const slide = document.createElement("div");
            slide.className = 'carousel-item' + (index === 0 ? ' active' : '');
            slide.style.paddingInline = "16px";
            slide.appendChild(item);
            inner.appendChild(slide);

            const indicator = document.createElement("button");
            indicator.type = "button";
            indicator.setAttribute("data-bs-target", "#services-carousel");
            indicator.setAttribute("data-bs-slide-to", index);
            if (index === 0) indicator.classList.add("active");
            indicators.appendChild(indicator);
          });

          carousel.classList.remove("d-none");
          carouselInstance = new bootstrap.Carousel(carousel, {
            interval: false,
            ride: false,
          });

          updateArrowStates();
          carousel.addEventListener("slid.bs.carousel", () => {
            updateArrowStates();
          });
          carousel
            .querySelectorAll(".custom-nav, .carousel-indicators")
            .forEach((el) => el.classList.remove("d-none"));
        });
      }

      function disableCarousel() {
        if (!carouselInstance) return;
        const carousel = document.getElementById("services-carousel");
        if (!carousel) return;

        const inner = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-inner");
        const slides = Array.from(inner.children);

        const row = document.createElement("div");
        row.className = "row justify-content-between services";

        slides.forEach((slide) => row.appendChild(slide.firstChild));

        carouselInstance.dispose();
        carouselInstance = null;

        carousel.replaceWith(row);
        row.classList.remove("d-none");
      }

      function handleResponsive() {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
          enableCarousel();
        } else {
          disableCarousel();
          document.querySelector(".services").classList.remove("d-none");
          const carousel = document.querySelector("#services-carousel");
          if (carousel) carousel.classList.add("d-none");
        }
      }
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        handleResponsive();
        const carouselEl = document.querySelector(".service-carousel");
        const isRTL = document.documentElement.dir === "rtl";

        if (isRTL && carouselEl) {
          const instance =
            bootstrap.Carousel.getInstance(carouselEl) ||
            new bootstrap.Carousel(carouselEl);

          const nextBtn = carouselEl.querySelector(".carousel-control-next");
          const prevBtn = carouselEl.querySelector(".carousel-control-prev");

          nextBtn.removeAttribute("data-bs-slide");
          prevBtn.removeAttribute("data-bs-slide");

          nextBtn.addEventListener("click", () => instance.prev());
          prevBtn.addEventListener("click", () => instance.next());
        }

        window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
          // equalizeSlideHeights();
          clearTimeout(window.__carouselResize);
          window.__carouselResize = setTimeout(handleResponsive, 150);
        });
      });
		const truncateElements = document.querySelectorAll(".truncate");
     const charLimit = 800; 

truncateElements.forEach(el => {
   const fullText = el.textContent.trim();
  el.dataset.fullText = fullText; // store full text

  // Initial truncation
  if (fullText.length > charLimit) {
    el.textContent = fullText.slice(0, charLimit) + "...";
    el.dataset.truncated = "true";
  }

  // Click to toggle
  el.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (el.classList.contains("expanded")) {
      // Collapse
      el.textContent = fullText.slice(0, charLimit) + "...";
      el.classList.remove("expanded");
    } else {
      // Expand
      el.textContent = fullText;
      el.classList.add("expanded");
    }
  });
});

<script>
      let carouselInstance = null;

      function waitForCardContent(container) {
        const images = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("img"))
          .filter((img) => !img.complete)
          .map(
            (img) =>
              new Promise((resolve) => {
                img.onload = resolve;
                img.onerror = resolve;
              })
          );
        return Promise.all(images);
      }
      let tallestSlideHeight = null;

      function updateArrowStates() {
        if (!carouselInstance) return;
        const carousel = document.getElementById("services-carousel");
        const slides = carousel.querySelectorAll(".carousel-item");
        const prevBtn = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-control-prev");
        const nextBtn = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-control-next");

        const activeIndex = Array.from(slides).findIndex((slide) =>
          slide.classList.contains("active")
        );

        const isRTL = document.documentElement.dir === "rtl";

        if (!isRTL) {
          prevBtn.classList.toggle("disabled", activeIndex === 0);
          nextBtn.classList.toggle(
            "disabled",
            activeIndex === slides.length - 1
          );
        } else {
          prevBtn.classList.toggle(
            "disabled",
            activeIndex === slides.length - 1
          );
          nextBtn.classList.toggle("disabled", activeIndex === 0);
        }
      }

      function enableCarousel() {
        if (carouselInstance) return;
        const container = document.querySelector(".services");
        if (!container) return;
        container.classList.add("d-none");
        const serviceCols = document.querySelectorAll(
          "#services-root .row.services .col-md-6"
        );
        serviceCols.forEach((col) => {
          col.classList.remove( "mb-4");

          
        });
        waitForCardContent(container).then(() => {
          const carousel = document.getElementById("services-carousel");
          const inner = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-inner");
          const indicators = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-indicators");

          inner.innerHTML = "";
          indicators.innerHTML = "";

          const items = Array.from(container.children);

          items.forEach((item, index) => {
            const slide = document.createElement("div");
            slide.className = 'carousel-item' + (index === 0 ? ' active' : '');
            slide.style.paddingInline = "16px";
            slide.appendChild(item);
            inner.appendChild(slide);

            const indicator = document.createElement("button");
            indicator.type = "button";
            indicator.setAttribute("data-bs-target", "#services-carousel");
            indicator.setAttribute("data-bs-slide-to", index);
            if (index === 0) indicator.classList.add("active");
            indicators.appendChild(indicator);
          });

          carousel.classList.remove("d-none");
          carouselInstance = new bootstrap.Carousel(carousel, {
            interval: false,
            ride: false,
          });

          updateArrowStates();
          carousel.addEventListener("slid.bs.carousel", () => {
            updateArrowStates();
          });
          carousel
            .querySelectorAll(".custom-nav, .carousel-indicators")
            .forEach((el) => el.classList.remove("d-none"));
        });
      }

      function disableCarousel() {
        if (!carouselInstance) return;
        const carousel = document.getElementById("services-carousel");
        if (!carousel) return;

        const inner = carousel.querySelector(".carousel-inner");
        const slides = Array.from(inner.children);

        const row = document.createElement("div");
        row.className = "row justify-content-between services";

        slides.forEach((slide) => row.appendChild(slide.firstChild));

        carouselInstance.dispose();
        carouselInstance = null;

        carousel.replaceWith(row);
        row.classList.remove("d-none");
      }

      function handleResponsive() {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
          enableCarousel();
        } else {
          disableCarousel();
          document.querySelector(".services").classList.remove("d-none");
          const carousel = document.querySelector("#services-carousel");
          if (carousel) carousel.classList.add("d-none");
        }
      }
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        handleResponsive();
        const carouselEl = document.querySelector(".service-carousel");
        const isRTL = document.documentElement.dir === "rtl";

        if (isRTL && carouselEl) {
          const instance =
            bootstrap.Carousel.getInstance(carouselEl) ||
            new bootstrap.Carousel(carouselEl);

          const nextBtn = carouselEl.querySelector(".carousel-control-next");
          const prevBtn = carouselEl.querySelector(".carousel-control-prev");

          nextBtn.removeAttribute("data-bs-slide");
          prevBtn.removeAttribute("data-bs-slide");

          nextBtn.addEventListener("click", () => instance.prev());
          prevBtn.addEventListener("click", () => instance.next());
        }

        window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
          // equalizeSlideHeights();
          clearTimeout(window.__carouselResize);
          window.__carouselResize = setTimeout(handleResponsive, 150);
        });
      });

truncateElements.forEach(el => {

  // Initial truncation
  if (fullText.length > charLimit) {
    el.textContent = fullText.slice(0, charLimit) + "...";
    el.dataset.truncated = "true";
  }

  // Click to toggle
  el.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (el.classList.contains("expanded")) {
      // Collapse
      el.textContent = fullText.slice(0, charLimit) + "...";
      el.classList.remove("expanded");
    } else {
      // Expand
      el.textContent = fullText;
      el.classList.add("expanded");
    }
  });
});

			}
			else if (
				event.target.parentNode &&

			) {

				);

		<div class="journal-content-article " data-analytics-asset-id="104351" data-analytics-asset-title="WE Business Shared Data M2M" data-analytics-asset-type="web-content" data-analytics-web-content-resource-pk="2750756">

      <div class="container">
        <h4 class="text-primary mb-3 fw-bold text-en">
	WE Business Shared Data
</h4>
       
	<div class="text-en"> <p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">عزز كفاءة أعمالك باتصال سلس وبتكلفة اقتصادية. تُعد باقات الإنترنت المشترك للأعمال من WE حلاً متطوراً لتقنية M2M، حيث تتيح تجميع السعة (بالميجابايت) عبر شرائح متعددة، مما يسمح لأجهزتك بمشاركة البيانات من مجمع بيانات مركزي واحد. يمنح هذا الحل أجهزتك الحرية في التواصل، وتبادل المعلومات، والعمل بموثوقية تامة دون الحاجة إلى تدخل بشري.</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"><br />
التواصل بين الآلات (M2M) هو تماماً كما يبدو: أجهزة تتحدث مع بعضها البعض تلقائياً، وتتبادل البيانات وتؤدي المهام في الوقت الفعلي. مع حلول M2M من WE، لا تكتفي أجهزتك بالاتصال فحسب، بل تتعاون معاً لمساعدة أعمالك على العمل بشكل أذكى، أسرع، وأكثر كفاءة.</p>

<h4 class="mb-2 fw-bold mt-4">لماذا تختار باقات الإنترنت المشترك للأعمال من WE؟</h4>

<ul>
	<li><strong>توفير التكاليف: </strong>ادفع مقابل مجمع بيانات واحد بدلاً من خطط بيانات فردية لكل شريحة.</li>
	<li><strong>اتصال مرن وقابل للتوسع: </strong>أضف المزيد من الأجهزة بسهولة دون القلق بشأن خطط بيانات منفصلة.</li>
	<li><strong>تواصل موثوق (M2M):</strong> مثالي لتقنيات إنترنت الأشياء (IoT)، العدادات الذكية، أجهزة نقاط البيع (POS)، وغيرها من الأجهزة المتصلة.</li>
	<li><strong>إدارة مبسطة: </strong>راقب الاستهلاك عبر جميع الأجهزة من خلال لوحة تحكم واحدة.</li>
</ul>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">حوّل أجهزتك المتصلة إلى أدوات لتمكين أعمالك؛ قلل فترات التوقف، وحسّن الكفاءة، وابقَ على اتصال أينما كانت عملياتك.</p> </div>

        const swiper = new Swiper(".mySwiper", {
          slidesPerView: 3,
          spaceBetween: 40,
          navigation: {
            nextEl: ".swiper-button-next",

            0: { slidesPerView: 1.2 },

            1024: { slidesPerView: 3 },
          },
          on: {
            init: (swiperInstance) => {
              syncVisibleSlideHeights(swiperInstance);
              document.querySelector(".swiper").classList.add("swiper-loaded"); // 👈 show only after init
            },
            slideChange: syncVisibleSlideHeights,
            resize: syncVisibleSlideHeights,
          },
        });

        function syncVisibleSlideHeights(swiperInstance) {
          swiperInstance.slides.forEach((slide) => {
            slide.style.height = "auto";
          });

          const visibleSlides = swiperInstance.slides.filter((slide) =>
            slide.classList.contains("swiper-slide-visible")
          );

          let maxHeight = 166;
          visibleSlides.forEach((slide) => {
            const h = slide.offsetHeight;
            if (h > maxHeight) maxHeight = h;
          });

          visibleSlides.forEach((slide) => {
            slide.style.height = maxHeight + "px";
          });
        }

        // Watch for dynamic height changes
        const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
          syncVisibleSlideHeights(swiper);
        });

        swiper.slides.forEach((slide) => {
          ro.observe(slide);
        });
      });
    </script>

        const items = Array.from(packages.children);
        items.forEach((item) => {
          const slide = document.createElement("div");
          slide.className = "swiper-slide";
          slide.appendChild(item);
          wrapper.appendChild(slide);
        });
        swiper.appendChild(wrapper);
        packages.replaceWith(swiper);

        swiper.insertAdjacentHTML(
          "beforeend",
          `
      <div class="swiper-pagination"></div>

      function disableSwiper() {
        if (!swiperInstance) return;
        const packagesSwiper = document.querySelector(".packages-swiper");

        const row = document.createElement("div");

        swiperInstance = null;

 <script>
      let swiperInstance = null;
      function enableSwiper() {
        if (swiperInstance) return;
        const packageRoot = document.querySelector("#packages-root");
        packageRoot.style.position = "relative";
        packageRoot.style.overflow = "hidden";
        packageRoot.style.paddingBottom = "20px";
        const packages = document.querySelector(".packages");
        if (!packages) return;
        packages.querySelectorAll("[class*='col-md-']").forEach((col) => {
          col.classList.remove("col-md-6", "mb-4", "col-12");
        });
        const swiper = document.createElement("div");
        swiper.className = "packages-swiper swiper-loaded";
				swiper.style.padding = "0 35px";
        const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
        wrapper.className = "swiper-wrapper";
        const items = Array.from(packages.children);
        items.forEach((item) => {
          const slide = document.createElement("div");
          slide.className = "swiper-slide";
          slide.appendChild(item);
          wrapper.appendChild(slide);
        });
        swiper.appendChild(wrapper);
        packages.replaceWith(swiper);

        swiper.insertAdjacentHTML(
          "beforeend",
          `
      <div class="swiper-pagination"></div>
      <div class="swiper-button-next custom-nav">
        <img src="/documents/d/te-business/right-arrow" class="img-fluid" alt="" />
      </div>
      <div class="swiper-button-prev custom-nav">
        <img src="/documents/d/te-business/left-arrow" class="img-fluid" alt="" />
      </div>
    `
        );
        swiperInstance = new Swiper(".packages-swiper", {
          slidesPerView: 1.2,
          spaceBetween: 32,
          centeredSlides: false,
          pagination: {
            el: ".swiper-pagination",
            clickable: true,
          },
          navigation: {
            nextEl: ".swiper-button-next",
            prevEl: ".swiper-button-prev",
          },

          autoHeight: true,
        });
        document.querySelector("#packages-root").classList.remove("d-none");
      }

      function disableSwiper() {
        if (!swiperInstance) return;
        const packagesSwiper = document.querySelector(".packages-swiper");
        if (!packagesSwiper) return;
        const wrapper = packagesSwiper.querySelector(".swiper-wrapper");
        const row = document.createElement("div");
        row.className = "row justify-content-between packages";
        swiperInstance.destroy(true, true);
        swiperInstance = null;
        packagesSwiper.replaceWith(row);
      }

      function handleResponsive() {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
          enableSwiper();
        } else {
          document.querySelector("#packages-root").classList.remove("d-none");
          disableSwiper();
        }
      }
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        handleResponsive();
        window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
          clearTimeout(window.__swiperResize);
          window.__swiperResize = setTimeout(handleResponsive, 150);
        });
      });
    </script>

</h4>
       
	<div class="text-en"> <p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">توفر خدمة IP Transit الدخول في جميع أنحاء العالم إلى شبكات الويب العالمية باستخدام اتصال IP بجودة عالية، دون تنازع وبوقت استجابة منخفض، متصلة مباشرة بالأعمدة الأساسية الدولية للإنترنت من خلال أنظمة الكابلات البحرية الدولية وأنظمة الإرسال الأرضية.</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">WE IP Transit هو اتصال إنترنت مخصص مُدار بالكامل وقابل للتطوير ومصمم خصيصًا لتلبية احتياجات الأعمال عالية الجودة. تستمر ريادة WE في خدمات الإنترنت المخصصة في تقديم وصول سلس إلى الإنترنت، وهو مصمم لتقديم أداء دائم وموثوق واستثنائي للتطبيقات ذات المهام الحرجة بأسعار تنافسية.</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">- خدمة الإنترنت المخصص هي عبارة عن اتصال إنترنت بجودة مضمونة وثبات مستمر طوال الوقت تتم إدارته بشكل كامل.</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">- نقدم الإنترنت المخصص بأسعار تنافسية، وبسرعات ربط متغيرة، تتراوح قدرة الدائرة من 64 كيلوبايت في الثانية لعشرات الجيجابايت في الثانية.</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">- يتم تقديم الخدمة عبر مجموعة متنوعة من أحدث تقنيات ألياف الفايبر بالإضافة إلى حلول التراسل عبر الـ WiMAX والأقمار الصناعية V-SAT.</p> </div>

        <h4 class="text-primary mb-3 fw-bold text-en">

</h4>
       
	<div class="text-en"> <p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">قم بتبسيط الأمر لموظفيك للتفاعل بأمان مع تطبيقات الأعمال، في مكان العمل، في الميدان أو في المنزل..</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">تمنحك الشبكة الافتراضية الخاصة لبروتوكول الإنترنت (IP-VPN) الخاصة بنا منظمة خاصة آمنة تستخدم أحدث ابتكارات الوصول الثابت والمحمول. لذلك، سوف تقدر التوفر المدرك من الناحية المالية، مع خيارات الوصول عن بُعد والمتعدد الاستخدامات.</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">تشير إدارة (QoS) إلى أنه يمكنك التركيز على التطبيقات الأساسية للأعمال والمكالمات وحركة مرور الفيديو، كما أن المساعدة متعددة الاستخدامات للتطوير والتعديل حسب حاجتك إليها. لذلك يمكنك تقليل التكاليف وزيادة تطوير الكفاءة من خلال استخدام منظمة فردية لكل ما تحتاجه</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">- خدمة الشبكة الخاصة الافتراضية توفر الربط بين فروع الشركات والمؤسسات وربطها بالمركز الرئيسي ومشاركة كميات كبيرة من المعلومات والموارد فيما بينها بشكل متزامن وآمن</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">- نقدم الخدمة بأسعار تنافسية وسرعات ربط مختلفة تناسب متطلبات جميع الشركات بمختلف أحجامها</p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium"> </p>

<p class="mb-0 font-18 fw-medium">- يتم تقديم الخدمة عبر مجموعة متنوعة من أحدث تقنيات ألياف الفايبر بالإضافة إلى حلول التراسل عبر الـ WiMAX والأقمار الصناعية V-SAT.</p> </div>
